project.name: Kings Gate International School
project.description:
Kayron Global Tech Services designed and developed a customized School Management System for Kings Gate International School.

The solution supports the management of student information, staff records and essential school administration activities through a centralized digital platform.

The project demonstrates our commitment to developing practical, user-friendly and scalable software solutions for educational institutions.

project.name: NCRI-Ghana
project.description: Website for the Northern Community Resilience Initiative (NCRI-Ghana), a development organisation in Saboba, Northern Region, working with women, girls, young people and vulnerable households. The site presents the organisation's six programme pillars: child protection and education, women and girls, agriculture and rural livelihoods, youth, climate and community resilience, and water, sanitation and hygiene. It includes the organisation's vision, mission and values, photo stories for each area of work, impact figures and learning, links to the UN Sustainable Development Goals, a gallery and news, and clear routes to partner, volunteer, donate or get in touch.

project.name: AI Workforce
project.description: A subscription platform that gives each business a private team of AI employees: an AI Team Coordinator plus specialists in finance, marketing, customer service, human resources, operations, projects, research and technology. Businesses describe a job in plain words; the coordinator assigns specialists and returns one combined draft for a person to approve. Includes a knowledge library with encrypted document storage and Google Drive import, per-employee access control, approvals, analytics, plans in Ghana cedis with a 14-day free trial, and Kombian, a built-in help assistant.
